## H2: heavy producers

Authors matched by normalised name strings (arXiv has no author identifiers). Namesake-robust: full first names only, the 1% most frequent surnames removed. Physics excludes papers with more than 50 authors (collaboration papers, which otherwise dominate author counts). Experimental physics has only about 300 such papers a quarter and very few authors with full first names, so only its all-names version is shown. No statistic describing fewer than ten authors is shown ("<10 authors").
